lines.en: I crawl forward a segment at a time.
My body is all segments.
I wear the colors of poison.
I feel my way as I crawl.
I have more feet than you can count.
I head for the shade.
I climb over a stone.
I do not crawl fast at all.
I crawl toward your side.
My color matches the grass.
I crawl without a sound.
My segments stir.
I cling under a leaf.
I lie on the leaf to warm up.
I probe forward.

lines.zh: 叶脉的阴影把我盖住了。
lines.en: The leaf's veins shadow me completely.
I am a little damp.
I shifted my body to face elsewhere.
I keep myself hidden.
You stepped on this grass.
I lift my front to look at you.
My colors are a warning.

lines.zh: 你踩到这片草了，退开一点。
lines.en: You stepped on this grass — back off a little.
I shrank back.

lines.zh: 你的影子把我整个盖住
lines.en: Your shadow covers all of me.
I am small, but not good to eat.
The spines are on my back.
Move a little farther away.
I rear up to look bigger.
I curled my body into a ball.
I rolled off to one side.
A bit of my shell cracked.
I cannot even cry out.
A little green fluid leaked.
I ease my body open a little.
I have not been crushed.
You stepped very true.

lines.zh: 我这副小身板，牙齿有毒。
lines.en: Small as I am, my fangs are venomous.
I burrow into the grass.
That is not on my menu.
Leaves suit me.
You have no leaf in your hand.
That smells wrong.
Set it on a blade of grass.
Let my antennae touch it first.
I am not greedy at all.
I crawl back into the grass.
You stepped beside me.
I recoiled backward.
I am very soft.
You nearly crushed me.
I crawl away from your boot.
I bumped into a grass stalk.
That did not even bend the grass.
I rolled half a turn.
I crawl back quickly.
Do not put your foot on me.
No hurry for that.
There are many of my kind in the grass.
I am following a scent trail.
You are in my way.
I will handle it myself.
I am crawling over that way.
We are not the same kind.

lines.zh: 数据流里，我认出了同频。
lines.en: In the stream of data I found a matching frequency.
I cannot hold this.
These feet of mine are too thin.
It is pressing my grass.
I crawl around past it.
It did not move at all.
There are insects underneath it.
I cannot do it myself.
This string of data; I swallow it down.
You are standing where I must pass.
I raise my front at you.
Do not reach out to touch me.
I have reared up.
Just move aside.
I can only keep going forward.
My venom is not a toy.
Do not reach toward me.
Just this one sting.

lines.zh: 你的影子先落到我身上
lines.en: Your shadow reached me first.
My venom is ready.
I crawl at your feet.
You move; I turn with you.
I keep pressed low to the ground.
My colors shifted.
I am right by your boot.
I rear up, ready to sting.
You backed off half a pace.
I am still moving forward.
The grass is covering for me.
When you stop, I speed up.
I stung you.
My stinger touched you.
This one is very small.
You snatched your hand back.
There is not much venom in me.
I bumped your foot.
You moved out of the grass.
I shrank back at once.
I did not mean to kill you.
I offer my stinger.

lines.zh: 我的小颚咬住你的指节。
lines.en: My small jaws clamp onto your knuckle.
I crawl out from under a leaf.
One more worm in this grass.
I have been in this area all along.
My colors are bright in the light.
I come up from under the leaf.
You must crouch to find me.
I head for your feet.
There is still soil on me.
My segments are moving one by one.
I begin looking for cover.
The grass here is good.
I will vanish soon enough.

lines.zh: 火把草和我的颜色都烧黑了
lines.en: Fire blackened the grass and my colors.
The blast threw me far.
A thin spike pierced my segment.
The spell numbs my segments.
I finished this leaf.
The flash lit all of me.
There is not a blade of grass here.
